title: Pilot wiring on mkreyman/infra

story.so_that: the pilot's 20 changes run with no pull request

rationale: PRD §2 success criteria and §9 decisions, approved 2026-09-26.

acceptance_criteria.description: infra's master ruleset restricts updates to the loopctl App, requires linear history and blocks force pushes and deletion; a test push by a person is refused.
A loop/** ruleset blocks force pushes and deletion.
infra's workflows run on push to loop/**.
The fleet hooks that are PR-shaped (gate-unmerged-pr, ci-status, wait-for-checks, review-round-counter) have thread-aware behaviour for a thread-mode repository.
The pilot's success criteria are measured and reported after 20 changes.

test_cases.name: rulesets
steps: push to master as a person; force push to loop/x

technical_notes: Enable only after US-45.5 is green on a scratch branch.
